method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, exact formula, reference and macro replay, and reverse paraphrase of regularity and the closure definition. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Regular total functions, general recursive closure, and equality with total recursive functions.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A total f(x,z-vector) is regular if every parameter vector admits an x with value zero. General recursive functions form the least class containing zero, successor and projections, closed under composition, primitive recursion and unbounded search only on regular functions.
samples.checks: The forall-parameters/existential-x order, zero condition, totality and every closure operation remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: General recursive functions are total; the other definition may use partial recursive intermediate functions but requires a total final result. Although general appears narrower, the two resulting classes coincide.
samples.checks: The apparent comparison direction and final equality claim, including both cross-references, are preserved.
